info.longName: DoubleLine Shiller CAPE U.S. Equities ETF

funds_data.description: Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets in U.S. equity securities, including exchange-traded investment companies that provide exposure to U.S. equity securities, subject to the limitations. It may invest in equity securities of companies of any market capitalization other than penny stocks. The fund is non-diversified.
